safety.title: Safety and honesty
safety.lead: Six rules that protect you and others when you work with AI.

sections.title: Protect personal data
sections.text: AI services may store your conversations and use them to improve their models. Don't send anything you wouldn't tell a stranger.
items: Passwords, SMS codes and access keys
Your home address and phone number
ID numbers, passport and bank card details
Other people's personal data without permission

sections.title: AI can be wrong
sections.text: An answer can sound confident and still contain invented facts, dates and links.
items: Check important facts against two reliable sources
Open links yourself
Discuss medical, legal and financial questions with a professional

sections.title: School and work rules
sections.text: Schools, universities and workplaces have their own AI rules. Find out what they are in advance.
items: If you're unsure what's allowed, ask your teacher or manager
Say that you used AI when the rules require it
Don't upload work documents to AI without permission

sections.title: Copyright
sections.text: Texts, images and music belong to their authors, even if AI helped you find or rework them.
items: Use material with a suitable licence
Read the service's terms before using results commercially
Note when an image or voice was made with AI

sections.title: Honesty
sections.text: AI helps you learn and work faster, but it shouldn't replace your work where you are the one being assessed.
items: Don't present generated text as your own
Don't use AI to get around rules or checks
Don't create fake photos, videos or voices of real people

sections.title: Look after yourself
sections.text: AI doesn't replace people or professional help.
items: If things are hard, talk to someone close, a teacher or a counsellor
Take breaks from the screen
Make decisions that matter for your life yourself

safety.footer: If you spot a mistake or outdated information on the site, let us know. We update the materials regularly.

privacy.title: Your data on Ailim
privacy.lead: A plain, point-by-point account of what the site stores, where, for how long and how to delete it. Everything below was checked against how the site actually works.

sections.title: What your account stores
items: Your name or nickname and email
Your password — only as a salted scrypt hash. It can't be read or recovered from the hash
Completed lessons and the step where you stopped; completed exercises
Bookmarks and viewing history (last 200 entries)
Your learning plan from the starter quiz
Settings: language, theme, text size, motion, reminders

sections.title: What stays only in your browser
items: Without an account, language, theme, text size, motion and the quiz plan are kept in this browser only. After you sign up, the plan moves to your account
Without an account, lesson progress, exercises and bookmarks are not saved
Text you write in practice and the prompt builder is never sent anywhere: not to us and not to external AI services
Signing in uses a session cookie. It is used only to keep you signed in, never for advertising

sections.title: How long data is kept
items: Account data — until you delete your account
Sign-in session — 30 days or until you sign out. Expired sessions are removed automatically about every 6 hours
A password reset link is valid for 1 hour and works once

When you delete your account, data is removed from the database immediately. The database provider keeps a 6-hour restore history: during that time deleted data still technically exists in the backup history, then it is gone for good
The hosting provider keeps technical request logs (page address, IP address, time). Their retention is set by Render

sections.title: How to download or delete data
items: Download: Settings → Download my data. You get a JSON file with your profile, progress, bookmarks and history
Delete: Settings → Delete account, then confirm with your password. Deletion is immediate and permanent
You can change your name, password and settings there at any time

sections.title: Who processes the data
items: Site hosting: Render, server in Frankfurt (Germany)
Database: Neon, server in Frankfurt (AWS, eu-central-1)
We use no advertising, analytics or third-party trackers. Fonts are served from our own server
Links to AI tools lead to their websites, where their own rules apply

sections.title: How data is protected
items: The site works over HTTPS only
The database connection is encrypted (TLS with certificate verification)
The sign-in cookie can't be read by page scripts (HttpOnly), is sent over HTTPS only (Secure) and only to our site (SameSite=Lax)
Sign-in attempts are rate-limited to make password guessing harder

privacy.footer: If anything here doesn't match what you see on the site, let us know. We'll fix either the site or this description.
